definitions.explanation: The world in which people live; society and its customs, trends, and realities.

examples.japanese: {世|よ}の{中|なか}には{色々|いろいろ}な{人|ひと}がいる。
examples.english: There are all kinds of people in the world.

examples.japanese: {世|よ}の{中|なか}は{変|か}わった。
{世|よ}の{中|なか}{甘|あま}くない。
examples.english: Life isn't easy. / The world is harsh.

notes:
USAGE: {世|よ}の{中|なか} refers to society and the realities of life. It's often used to make general statements about how the world works.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{世|よ}の{中|なか}は〜 (the world is ~)
・{世|よ}の{中|なか}に{出|で}る (to go out into the world)
・{世|よ}の{中|なか}を{渡|わた}る (to get along in the world)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{世界|せかい} - world (physical/global)
・{社会|しゃかい} - society (more formal)
・{世間|せけん} - the public, society
